Very nice jacket. Doesn’t look very chunky but it’s gorgeous. But it’s not that much oversized as it claims so you can size up for the oversized look. Quality is very nice according to the price. It’s not super warm and I think it’s not supposed to be one of those kind but you can wear it during mild winter and indoor. It’s comfy and doesn’t smell. The zipper is nice as well.
This is a very nice jacket! It’s only oversized length wise though so it’s longer but not wide so if you have wide shoulders size up!

products.product_name: High-Waist Origin Wide Leg Track Pant
products.search_term: Alo Yoga High-Waist Origin Wide Leg Track Pant

reviews.body:
These pants are incredibly soft and comfortable, the fabric feels amazing on. They have a very classy look and can easily be dressed up or down, which makes them super versatile. I’ve worn them lounging, running errands, and even out, and they always look great.

The fit is flattering, the waistband is comfortable, and the quality feels really good. Overall, the comfort is outstanding and they’ve quickly become a favorite in my closet.

Highly recommend

At this point I am basically a CRZ Yoga evangelist. I LOVE their no front seam leggings and shorts and sports bras for working out. I initially ordered another wide leg pants from them that was more legging like and returned them because I wanted more "work wear" style. Those were thinner and had a front seam. These pants though.. these are the perfect blend of fashion and comfort!!
I'm a fit 5'5 155lb and based on others reviews and the size recs, went with Large and I'm glad I did. My actual waist measurement is 31.5". They fit like a glove in waist, but don't pinch at all. There is a little stretch, but not a lot. The length is perfect to wear with flats, and the drape in the front And back are very flattering.
The fabric is a heavier, but flowy weight that has stretch to it and helps with smoothing and wrinkle resistance. These pics were taken just after opening package so haven't washed yet, but I will probably hang dry or dry inside out on gentle. Can't wait to get these in more colors!

I love these pants so much that I ended up ordering a second pair. A friend of mine was wearing them while pregnant and I kept thinking how good they looked on her, so I had to try them myself. I’m not pregnant, but I do have a belly, and these work really well for me.

They’re super soft and stretchy, very comfortable, and actually flattering. I can wear them to work, lounge in them, or run errands without feeling sloppy. The high waist is supportive without digging in. They are thick enough that it doesn't look like spandex or tight workout clothes.

For reference, I’m 5’7” and around 200 lbs, and they fit me really nicely. I also love this brand in general, I own multiple things from CRZ YOGA and they’ve all been great.

Definitely recommend if you want comfy pants that still look put together

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Marl Sweater 1/4 Zip Pullover

reviews.body: I can't go on enough about CRZ YOGA products. I'm obsessed. This half zip sweater looks so much nicer in person than it does on the model pictured. I say this because it looks a little boxy in the pic. It is so nicely made and fitted when you actually put it on. I am 5'2" 120lbs and I ordered a small. It looks expensive. The material is soft. I will order in black as well!
My favorite pullover! Soft, breathable, and cooling. It’s well-made and comfortable for long wear. I use it for running and hiking, and it’s perfect for staying active without overheating.

When I am not at work, I live in sweaters and sweats, so I have lots of mismatched ones for at home for optimal comfort, but sometimes it's nice to feel comfy and cute.
So soft, high quality, neutral color, but not overally heavy weighted--I love it. It's the 'cool-like', soft texture that all the high-end activewear brands seem to use.
It is perfect for lounging around the house and feeling put together, or polished enough for going out and about with white sneakers. It feels way more expensive than what I paid for it. The length is slightly cropped, so I recommend if you want it for lounge-ability and comfort to go for your bigger size if in between sizes. This top also would be great with leggings for a work out class or the gym. I totally recommend and would buy again.
I bought the set in medium.

products.product_name: Snuggle Up Sweater High-Waist Wide Leg Pant
products.search_term: Alo Yoga Snuggle Up Sweater High-Waist Wide Leg Pant

reviews.body: Pants are soft and very comfortable. Fit was good.
True to size, nice quality & super comfortable. Feels like pjs but looks like pants. Perfect for travelling & daily wear. I bought 2 more colors, after seeing how great the first pair was.
These are very comfortable and fit my daughter great. She loves the look and quality. They have become one of her favorite paid of pants.

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Snuggle Up Sweater Shawl

reviews.body: I love this hooded blanket/jacket! I ordered one to try it out. After wearing it for 1 hour, I ordered two more: One for my cat, who absolutely adores it and wouldn't leave me alone so I bought one for her own use, and a second one for myself in case this product suddenly becomes unavailable. This is the warmest and softest item of clothing that I own. The material unexpectedly retains my body heat such that I am truly toasty in my 64° home. I wear it now all the time, and really appreciate it. Particularly, while working at my computer. The material is cut such that it covers from the top of my head, down my back, to below my rear and the long wings of the blanket totally cover my arms and extend below and warm my knees when I am seated at the computer or my desk, piano, etc. The hood is so large that I can double it back on itself, providing even more warmth. I don't bother with the buttons under the arm pits, as they're not necessary and it's easier to put the cloak on and off. I treat the item as a hooded shawl more than as a jacket. I love the pockets as hand warmers. My hands are always cold and interfere with typing accuracy, as well as feeling miserable. A few minutes of putting my hands in the conveniently-placed front pockets, and my hands are warm. Something that has never happened with any other jacket that I have worn. There's something about the manufacture of the material that really holds the body warmth in. Whatever. I love this item. I'm going to buy two more. I can't imagine not wearing this item in the future in my house, which stays cool even in the summer. I also look forward to keeping my propane bill down this winter. It's late November and I haven't had to turn on my furnace yet. I even sleep in this jacket. I really appreciate the hood, which keeps my head and neck, shoulders and arms, actually my entire torso, warm and toasty. I can honestly say this is the best $25 I ever spent on an item of clothing. I wish I had found it a long time ago.

I wouldn't say this look like some high ticket item, but it's lovely and soft and washes like a dream. Be prepared to either sew the button holes up a bit, or buy bigger buttons, whichever is your preference. The button holes to make the "sleeves" will simply not stay buttoned on the one I have, but that's an easy and quick fix. I will say you can easily size down. I'm tall and a big gal, and it swallows me, so I could have done with one size down, but I do like the big "comfy blanket" feel, so I'm not unhappy with that factor. This is also a really pretty color in person, maybe a little more shaded to a rosy tan than it portrays, but close enough, and lovely. Definitely happy with this purchase!

I’ve had this for less than a week and I already ordered another in a different color. I didn’t get it to wear out, but to use when I’m home, especially sitting on the sofa. It is perfect! Nice quality, very soft and cozy and it keeps me warm but given the great design I can toss it open when I warm up too much. I like the length (below knee on me) because it’s long enough to do the job but not so long it gets tangled in things. The buttons make it very flexible and versatile. It so nice to be all wrapped up and yet be able to slip my hand out of the side to grab the remote.

This is basically a cozy blanket with form. Because of that form you can stand up and walk around with it, hands free, or you can easily slip out of it and leave it on the sofa if you prefer. I’m just loving it! Perfect for the way I spend many of my evenings.

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Cropped Gold Rush Puffer Vest

reviews.body: Cropped fits true to size. If in between go up not down. This fest is being used for accents on certain outfits but it’s not an every day vest. The style is fun and fashion forward.
Great fit, soft and many compliments!

The vest was exactly as described. I purchased it for mi niece who needed it for a dance performance outfit. The color and the material was exactly as we needed it. I just suggest that if you order it for teens to request a smaller size because it comes a little bit bigger. My niece is 13 years old and I ordered size M. It looked loose. She ended not using it as the coach change the outfit at very last minute but still the vest material and quality was excellent. 😊💯

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Stargazing Puffer

reviews.body: The material is awesome.. love them so much

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Origin Full-Zip Track Jacket

reviews.body: I have this jacket in both black and white. It is a great athleisure jacket. I love the quality and weight/softness of the fabric. The cut is fitted enough to be super flattering and the length is perfect. The front zipper and pocket zippers are good quality and zip smoothly. The style works great for both working out or wearing as a casual, lightweight jacket. This was a great value for the price, and is priced so you can buy more colors when you love it!
Great quality. Normally size XL in active wear but ordered XXL. Perfect fit. Color is between navy and darkest teal. I like it.
I like the fit of this jacket. Very slimming and comfortable. I walk 5 miles a day and the back panel keeps me cool. Like the style.

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Elemental Full-Zip Jacket

reviews.body:
I love the quality, fit, and fabric of this jacket. I have several that I have bought over the years. As the years have gone by, some of the features have changed mildly, but overall they are excellent. I wear them almost daily; inside to break the chill and outside in the cooler weather. It’s lightweight and breathable with great stretchy material. It is definitely true to size, I tried to downsize since they were sold out in my XL, but the L was just too small and tight in the arms. I learned my lesson and won’t size down again.
This is definitely one of my favorite things to wear.
I have this color and black. They seem to sell out quickly in my size or I would have more colors!

This jacket is well-made, true to size, has great features (slimming seams, zipper cover at the neck, zip pockets, and thumb holes), and is made of lightweight fabric. It's not a dupe for Lululemon because it's not scuba material/thick, but I like this jacket for that reason. If you are looking for soft, body-hugging comfort that still makes you look great, this IS THE JACKET FOR YOU. I'm a curvy girl (size 12+ on top), and it fits like a glove. No pulling, tugging, rolling, or buckling. This is going to be on my favorite list, and I'll be buying it in more colors. Note: The color shown on Amazon exactly matches what I received. My photos came out more electric blue and don't accurately show the color.
Nice , snug but comfortable, soft

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Northstar Cargo Pant

reviews.body: I've never reviewed anything on Amazon but I felt inclined to review these pants because they are 11/10. The Navy is a beautiful inky blue and the material is an exact dupe for LLL dance studio. I prefer these over my LLL DS cargo pants in every way: fit is more flattering and TTS, the cargo pockets snap closed, and the hardware is more lightweight so they dont clunk around the dryer as much. Plus! The pinched cable can be stored in the cargo pocket instead of flapping around my ankles. Genius. I will be purchasing more colors and living in these pants allsummer (and taking the name brand pants to the consignment shop)

Absolutely perfection! The fabric is lightweight and soft. I love how the side cinches up and the design so it pulls up through the pocket is awesome. I found they run true to size—maybe a little big. I’m 5’2” and about 110. The XS is loose but not too loose. I’m going to order a 2nd pair but in an XXS. I hope there will be more colors!

Super cute and comfy! Ordered these to use as a hiking pant for my honeymoon in Glacier national park. I wore these on the Grinnel Glacier hike (12 miles round trip) and they were awesome. Super lightweight and breathable. Washed up nice in the washer as well!

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Rain Or Shine Long Coat

reviews.title: They thought of everything!
reviews.body:
It runs so big! I am normally a large, but I will be returning it to get a medium. I have a large head and this hood was very big on me and flopped over my face. Good if you have voluminous hair, perhaps.

Let’s address this early: the jacket does not come with a carrying pack; it folds up into its own left pocket and THAT is the carrying pack! Genius design. The pocket has a little carrying strap and a double sided zipper so that it can be closed from the outside or the inside. To fold: zip up the jacket and lay it flat right side up, fold the arms across the chest and fold the hood down at the neck. Fold the whole jacket in half so that front+sleeves+hood are on the outside. Fold in thirds. Flip over and the left front pocket will be in the center. Proceed to stuff into pocket, turning pocket inside out in the process. It’s a tight fit but it becomes easier with practice.

They thought of everything with this jacket. The upper back is sheer breathable mesh underneath the waterproof panel. The wrists, waist, and hood are adjustable. The hood has a flexible visor that can be folded back if needed, and the hood can be rolled up and stored in a narrow Velcro panel at the base of the neck. Plenty of length - the jacket reached my knees. Reflector patterns. Soft, stylish, lightweight, comfortable, well-made.

It does sound crunchy like a classic windbreaker, but not obnoxiously so.

I wish this jacket came in more colors that are on the muted side instead of stark black and bright pink and blue.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 2, 2025
reviews.author: Alyssa

reviews.title: Packable rainjacket reasonably priced & many features
reviews.body: Bayleaf has great exercing clothing and this raincoat caught my eye. The raincoat is reasonablly priced, and packable. There are two inside deep pockets as well as the pockets on the outside zip. The raincoat is long length on my petite height which is ok to keep the rain away. However, the sleeves are rather long on my petite frame so they are turned up creating a cuffed effect. I ordered the Medium which will be plently large enough to wear over a mid-weight winter jacket. Without a winter jacket or fleece, the raincoat will be roomy. The jacket has a hidden hood and the ability to create a nice sleek back that makes the raincoat breathable. Great find. Thanks
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 8, 2025
reviews.author: Southern Gal

reviews.title: A beautiful oversize coat
reviews.body:
Lovely color and well-made garment. I purchased a small but the sleeves are so long they cover most of my hands. The shoulder line extends at least 1.5 inches beyond my shoulders. The ample hood covers over half my face and impedes vision. The front hangs in folds. Will the manufacturer make an extra-small for us? I am almost 5'4" and 104 pounds. I will probably return it.

I kept the coat: I made a fold on the back side of the hood of about 1.5 inches and sewed it; this lifted the it so that I can see better. I have gotten more accustomed to it being oversize. I have gotten many compliments on it and can see that others think it's quite stylish.

Today I wore it in pouring rain for the first time. The rain never soaked my back but water seeped through my sleeves and the rest of the coat a bit. I'm relieved I wasn't soaking wet.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 1, 2025
reviews.author: Anon y mous

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Polar Fleece Wintry Mix Pant

reviews.body: The pants fit snug and I love them very comfortable. As far as the pockets they are close to your body, great for small flat items if you are intending to put things in the pockets, maybe a flat tissue, nothing bulky like keys. But i do love the fit and material is nice and soft, they are nice and warm as well. I ordered a large, my usual size, and they fit great!

I love these pants. I’m 5’3” and 110 lbs. I have a really hard time with pants being so baggy in the legs. These are perfect in a small size. Warm at 30°. Im ordering 2 more pairs. They are less expensive than some other high end brands but fit so much better and no bagging. They look well made and have comfortable pockets. The material is thick but not overly so. I was surprised at how warm they are outdoors. I have not washed them yet but they appear to be very well made.

These are great! For reference, I'm 5' 3 1/2" and weigh around 145lb. I bought a medium and a large. Super soft, nice high waist, side pockets, lightly fleece lined so I think they'll be warm without being too hot. The mediums are the exact right length and fit a tad tighter but I honestly can't choose which fit I like best so I'm keeping both pair.

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Edition Sueded Jacket

reviews.body: Fantastic fit. Runs true to size imo. I’m 5‘10“ with broad shoulders and long arms and have no for issues whatsoever with this. Hem sits solidly 4“ below belly button so plenty long with any rise of pants for me. Nice quality fabric and pretty robust zipper. Serious quality and reasonable price.

I was introduced to this brand this summer with their shorts. Was looking for a jacket like this but didn’t wanna pay Lulu prices! Absolutely love this jacket,the way it fits, the way it moves, the way it hugs my body, I will be getting more. For reference, I am 5’7 and 119 lbs. with a long torso, I also have broad shoulders. I could do the extra small for my waist, but it would be tied around my shoulders and arms. I I also only use it over tanks, not long sleeve tops.

If you’re thinking about it, just do it. This jacket is lightweight and buttery. Yes, it runs on the smaller side so if you’re in between sizes I would recommend choosing a size up. I’m usually a medium (went with a large) and the jacket fit perfect, nice and fitted. I ordered in another color as well!

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Airlift Rebel Bra

reviews.body: I love this top! The color is beautiful. The fit was as expected. The material is soft and gives me good support. I will be buying from this brand again. I love the quality of their sports bras.

I ordered according to the size chart and that was the right move. I hate the soft cup paddings that come in all bra tops so I always remove them and I like that these have removable cups. Let me tell you, this bra is so freaking comfortable it’s insane. This is going to be my go to for my long walks. It’s not super supportive so I wouldn’t wear it for high-impact activities, but for anything light it’s just perfect. I will definitely buy this again because it’s a great value and I love the style of the neckline and straps. I really liked that these straps didn’t fall off my shoulders and stay put. The stitching is perfect and I can tell this is going to be a durable purchase. I got the brown and it’s a nice neutral espresso color.
Great lulu dupe. Buttery soft and comfortable. Great coverage and support. I think I could actually run in this bra and have great support.

products.product_name: Polar Fleece Cropped Wintry Mix Jacket
products.search_term: Alo Yoga Polar Fleece Cropped Wintry Mix Jacket

reviews.body:
Bought this in the green for a football game, and it’s exactly the vibe I was going for. It has that soft, slightly sporty, slightly cute look — very “cheerleader off duty grabbing a hot chocolate” energy (which is absolutely a thing, and we’re leaning into it).

The material is super soft and nicely thick, so it feels comforting without being bulky. It’s warm, it’s true to size, and it hits that perfect spot between fitted and relaxed — like you didn’t try too hard, but the outfit came together anyway.

Haven’t washed it yet, so can’t speak to longevity, but straight out of the bag, it’s comfortable and flattering. Easy to pair with:
high-rise denim, joggers, leggings or even layered under a puffer for colder games...
Basically, it’s the kind of piece you throw on and instantly feel cute + cozy.
Love an effortless game day uniform.

Had quickly become my go to jacket to grab when I want to be cozy but still look cute. Material is thick and soft. I hang mine to dry but I think it would also be fine in the dryer. Definitely worth the money. I have a similar fleece jacket that cost twice as much from an athletic brand and these feel higher quality

I bought this jacket to throw on during my hospital shifts and it’s honestly become my everyday staple. It’s lightweight but still warm enough for chilly units and late-night walks to the parking garage. The fit is relaxed so it layers easily over scrubs without feeling tight in the shoulders, and the sleeves don’t ride up when I’m constantly moving around.

The material feels soft (not stiff or noisy) and it holds its shape even after long shifts sitting, charting, and running around. I also like that it looks put-together enough to wear outside of work — errands, school pickup, etc.

Great balance of comfort, warmth, and practicality. If you want something cozy but not a heavy winter coat, this is it.

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Airlift Intrigue Bra
Alo Yoga Seamless Ribbed Favorite Bra Tank

reviews.body: Super comfy, soft, and stretchy, yet supportive and thick. Great length for my short torso, hits slightly longer than the top of my hips. Scoop neck is just the right depth, ends at the top of my cleavage so none of it shows. Love wearing this out on walks and hikes so I don't get a farmer's tan from a t-shirt. Built in bra has thick bra pads that support and shape the girlies. Straps are thin but not too thin and do not dig, very comfortable. I am a 36D, but often like 38C for more comfort, hourglass shape, and the large is perfect for my band and cup size, and is slim but not fitted on my waist which is my preferred fit. Does not cling to belly. I haven't worn this for high impact like lots of jumping, but I've worn this jogging and felt fine. But for walks and hikes it is chef's kiss!

CRZ Yoga is a great affordable, alternative brand if you love Lululemon. The fabric has that same buttery soft feel, and has just the right amount of stretch. The pink color is just as pictured! Built-in bra is padded, and does a great job hiding those "headlights" (IYKYK!)

I am 5'2, 130 lbs and typically a C-Cup in most bras. The Medium fits me PERFECTLY! (Note: I do have a wide ribcage just FYI). It fits me snugly with no noticeable baggy spots. It is the perfect lenght, just reaching my belly button, so it does not feel like a crop top. This tank is GREAT QUALITY and I definitely recommend this brand! I will be ordering more in the future!

These workout tops and bras are great. My daughter is on a high school dance team and this is the brand that is requested as team practice wear by the coach. They are well made, buttery soft, comfortable, supportive, washes well and holds up to the abuse of a 16 year old dancer. It is washed and worn weekly during an entire school year. We have some from this brand 3 years old and they still look great, no fading, no problems with seams unraveling, no holes, etc. We have the leggings and they are great as well.

products.product_name: Airlift Winter Warm 1/4 Zip Long Sleeve
products.search_term: Alo Yoga Airlift Winter Warm 1/4 Zip Long Sleeve

reviews.body: Bought for a tennis tournament. The color is more teal than green, but is every nice and it is warm and not bulky.

This shirt is lightly lined fleece but perfect for the Arizona winter. It’s also oversized enough to wear other shirts underneath if you need to layer. The color is exactly as advertised and true to size. I am wearing an extra small and 5’7 110 pounds.
Lightweight but not flimsy. Fits true to size. Color and fabric are really nice. Super comfortable

products.search_term: Alo Yoga Airbrush High-Waist 7/8 Bootcut Legging

reviews.body:
I got these leggings after seeing them mentioned in a video. They are supposed to be a dupe of a popular active wear brand. I don't own the original, but as far as leggings go, these are very nice. They are soft, not see-through, thankfully. They wash up just fine. I always wash on cold and hang dry anything with spandex.
These have a high-waisted fit and are comfortable all day. The fact that they offer multiple lengths is so smart! I immediately shared with my friends who are of different heights because it's so nice to have that option to choose the length. The "hot fudge" is a dark brown color and exactly what is pictured. For reference, I am 5' 6", 140lbs, and I ordered the medium in the 32" length.

Better quality than my LuLulemon's, they wash nicely, I hang dry. The length is customizable, fabric is soft, and comfortable, breaths and wait band does not roll on me, just a very good quality happy with this brand have purchased over 10 items and all have been of excellent quality.

Super soft , dupe for luxury brand , great fit , high waist . Very comfortable, ordered a few more in other colors . Great price , great quality , no color bleeding , no shrinking , does run a bit larger , recommended sizing down .

products.search_term: Alo Yoga 5 Seamless Ribbed Favorite Short

reviews.body: Love these! They fit perfectly and run true to size. I would say if you're between sizes, just size up, they're meant to be compression, so it's better to have room. They're 100% squat-proof and do not ride up when you run. The only thing I hate is the label in the back. No one needs to know I bought these from Amazon. Overall, the quality is amazing. I would honestly compare it to expensive brands like Oner. They're very soft and look super cute. Completely worth the value.

i’m an alphalete girlie through and through, but with them always being sold out and selling out within minutes after a restock, it’s nearly impossible to snag one of their amplify shorts. i’ve been shopping around for dupes and honestly these come pretty close! they’re thick (but not too thick) and stretchy at the same time. literally the perfect amount of stretch! when doing leg day they do become a tiny bit loose but that’s expected as you’re stretching the cloth out during every rep. they’re compression is perfect, just make sure to get your right size!

i have tried dfyne but hate it as they’re too thick and not stretchy enough imo, so they were a waste of money! i got these for about $20 each and honestly they’re such a great price for their quality. i can’t wait to get more colors! they’re so flattering just like the alphalete amplify! these are better than aurola’s intensify shorts imo!

I am 5‘3“ and 140 lbs. I ordered size Medium. I have a large booty and thick upper thighs. I lift weights often and play pickle ball often so I’m quite muscular. I wanted some little shorts to go under my Pickleball dresses. My matching Pickleball shorts always ride up my legs and give me no compression. These give great compression, are comfortable, flattering, and do not ride up. Definitely ordering more colors.

reviews.body: Great bra for lifting and low impact cardio. Not a great bra for high impact. Very cute and with the cross in the back. Very comfortable and the material is soft like their leggings. It is very flattering as well.

I am a 34 small B and got an XS. I have worn it for a low impact workout class and weight training. Super soft and comfortable. Pads are removable. I got it in 3 colors and am about to purchase another color, it's so wonderful. Sexy and functional. WISH THEY MADE PATTERNS AND A SWIM VERSION FOR SUMMER! (would make an excellent bathing suit top - hint hint Aoxjox)

I never take the time to write reviews, but I wanted to leave a review on this one for my larger chested natural girlies. I love the look of these bras but never found a good fit until now. I’m naturally a 32 DD and so far this bra keeps the girls covered and in place (lefty tends to pop out in anything cut like this) while still maintaining sex appeal. The material is soft and stretchy and doesn’t cut into my ribs.

Knocking one star off because I’m not sure how the elastic will hold up, she feels a little weak. I also wouldn’t recommend running in this if you want to keep indecent exposure off your record.

Planning to buy this one in other colors…Hope my review helps & maybe makes you giggle!
